standard_prerequisites.use: Univalence, dependent sums and path transport, n-truncation, n-connected maps and the standard equivalence between iterated homotopy fibres and the fibre of a composite. The displayed exercise pointer for that elementary fibre identity is an explicitly allowed prerequisite, not an extracted exercise solution.

core_obligations: Construct the canonicaln-image factorization and the fibrewise equivalence comparing any two connected-truncated factorizations.
Upgrade the fibrewise comparison to an equivalence of intermediate types with both homotopies and the required coherence, proving the factorization space contractible.

proof_roadmap.step: Construct the canonicaln-image factorization and the fibrewise equivalence comparing any two connected-truncated factorizations.
Upgrade the fibrewise comparison to an equivalence of intermediate types with both homotopies and the required coherence, proving the factorization space contractible.

difficulty_reason: Uniqueness is asserted as contractibility of a type of factorizations, so an equivalence of intermediate types alone is insufficient. The two comparison homotopies and their coherence supply the additional H2 type-theoretic obligations.

compared.difference: Migrates this unpublished research claim once using the actual fixed official source; no second count beside the old record.
Homogeneous Freudenthal algebras/anisotropic quadratic forms is only a name collision, not suspension connectivity.
Hypercubical manifolds has a cubical presentation claim, not any of these three numbered book theorems.
